title: Classical and Ancient Works
summary: Topical headings are assigned to classical and ancient works (originals or translations) that have a topical orientation, reversing the pre-1950 LC policy of not doing so. Individual works of belles lettres on an identifiable topic get a literary form heading (e.g. topic--Drama).
validation_rules: Assign topical headings to topically oriented ancient works, original or translation, e.g. `Political science--Early works to 1800` for Aristotle's Politics. (H 1412 sec. 1)
Assign a literary form heading to individual works of belles lettres on an identifiable topic, e.g. `Oedipus (Greek mythology)--Drama`. (H 1412 sec. 2)
The pre-1950 LC policy of assigning no topical headings to classical and ancient works is no longer followed. (H 1412 Background)

sections.heading: 1. Topical works
sections.text:
Assign topical headings to any ancient work, original text or translation, that has a topical orientation. Example:

```
Title: Aristotle's Politics.
[a translation of the work by Aristotle]
650 #0 $a Political science $v Early works to 1800.
```

sections.heading: 2. Works of belles lettres
sections.text:
Assign a literary form heading to any individual work of belles lettres, original text or translation, on an identifiable topic. Example:

```
650 #0 $a Oedipus (Greek mythology) $v Drama.
```
